hook.say: Rivers and lakes! Five questions, three seconds each. Only real map lovers get the last one.

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: The Nile flows north, and its basin touches 11 countries.
questions.sayAnswer: The Nile! It flows north, and its basin touches 11 countries.

questions.q: Which river carries the most water in the world?
questions.fact: The Amazon carries about a fifth of all river water reaching the sea.
questions.sayAnswer: The Amazon! It carries about a fifth of all the river water that reaches the sea.

questions.q: Which is the deepest lake in the world?
questions.fact: Baikal, in Siberia, is over 1,600 meters deep. It is also the oldest lake.
questions.sayAnswer: Lake By-kal! This Siberian lake is over 1,600 meters deep. It is also the oldest lake on Earth.

questions.q: Lake Titicaca lies on the border of which two countries?
questions.fact: It sits about 3,800 meters up in the Andes, and big ships still sail it.
questions.sayAnswer: Peru and Bolivia! The lake sits about 3,800 meters up in the Andes, and big ships still sail it.

questions.q: Which major river crosses the equator twice?
questions.fact: The Congo is also the deepest river known, about 220 meters in places.
questions.sayAnswer: The Congo! It is also the deepest river known, about 220 meters in places.
